title: Finding remainder of 37^1000 divided by 9
subject: Mathematics
caption: Flowchart for computing the remainder of 37^1000 divided by 9
altText: A flowchart showing the logical steps: start, identify the expression 37 to the power of 1000, reduce the base modulo 9, compute 37 mod 9 which equals 1, replace the original expression with 1 to the 1000th power, simplify that to 1, and conclude that the remainder when dividing by 9 is 1, then end.
